description: This file contains core utility functions and classes for Ext JS 3.4.0, including namespace management, type checking, DOM manipulation, event handling, AJAX, animations, and region/point calculations, with some jQuery integration.

classes.name: Ext
classes.description: Singleton object providing core utilities, version info, namespace management, and class extension methods.

classes.name: Ext.util.TaskRunner
classes.description: Class for executing multiple tasks in a multithreaded manner, with start, stop, and stopAll methods.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Dom
classes.description: Namespace for DOM-related utility functions such as getViewWidth, getXY, setXY, etc.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Event
classes.description: Namespace for event handling functions like getPageX, getTarget, on, un, preventDefault, stopPropagation.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Ajax
classes.description: Namespace for AJAX request functions, wrapping jQuery.ajax.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Region
classes.description: Class representing a rectangular region with methods for containment, intersection, union, and constraining.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Point
classes.description: Class extending Region, representing a point with x and y coordinates.

methods.name: Ext.apply
methods.description: Copies properties from source object to target object.

methods.name: Ext.applyIf
methods.description: Copies properties from source to target only if they are undefined in target.

methods.name: Ext.extend
methods.description: Creates a subclass of a class with optional overrides.

methods.name: Ext.override
methods.description: Overrides methods of an existing class.

methods.name: Ext.namespace
methods.description: Creates nested namespaces.

methods.name: Ext.getDom
methods.description: Returns the DOM element for an Ext element, id, or DOM node.

methods.name: Ext.get
methods.description: Returns an Ext.Element for a DOM element or id.

methods.name: Ext.fly
methods.description: Returns a flyweight Ext.Element for DOM manipulation.

methods.name: Ext.getBody
methods.description: Returns the document body as an Ext.Element.

methods.name: Ext.getHead
methods.description: Returns the document head as an Ext.Element.

methods.name: Ext.isArray
methods.description: Checks if a value is an array.

methods.name: Ext.isDate
methods.description: Checks if a value is a Date object.

methods.name: Ext.isObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a plain object.

methods.name: Ext.isPrimitive
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string, number, or boolean.

methods.name: Ext.isFunction
methods.description: Checks if a value is a function.

methods.name: Ext.isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is a finite number.

methods.name: Ext.isString
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string.

methods.name: Ext.isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if a value is a boolean.

methods.name: Ext.isElement
methods.description: Checks if a value is an HTMLElement.

methods.name: Ext.isDefined
methods.description: Checks if a value is not undefined.

methods.name: Ext.util.TaskRunner
methods.description: Class for managing and executing multiple tasks.

methods.name: Ext.TaskMgr
methods.description: Singleton instance of TaskRunner for managing tasks.

methods.name: Ext.lib.Dom.getViewWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the viewport.

methods.name: Ext.lib.Dom.getXY
methods.description: Calculates the XY position of an element.

methods.name: Ext.lib.Dom.setXY
methods.description: Sets the XY position of an element.

methods.name: Ext.lib.Event.getPageX
methods.description: Returns the pageX coordinate of an event.

methods.name: Ext.lib.Event.getTarget
methods.description: Returns the target element of an event.

methods.name: Ext.lib.Ajax.request
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request using jQuery.ajax.

methods.name: Ext.lib.Region.getRegion
methods.description: Returns a Region object representing the position and size of an element.
